title: The existing canonical Kan-extension etale projection comparison
statement: For any closed symmetric monoidal Grothendieck abelian coefficient category A admitting small-site sheafification and any etale morphism e:V -> T, the canonical etaleLowerShriekTensorIso is an isomorphism e_!(M tensor e^*N) -> e_!M tensor N. It is natural jointly in M and N: e_!(f tensor e^*g) followed by the comparison is the comparison followed by e_!f tensor g. No separatedness, finite-type, flatness or torsion restriction is required.

source.place: Tag 0GKF, abstract projection isomorphism; formalized source EtaleMapProjection.lean, Projection section.

proof.text: The left Kan extension along the localization functor is pointwise a coproduct indexed by lifts. Tensoring preserves coproducts because it has a right adjoint. The universal Kan projection is therefore invertible on every test object. Its unit equation and joint naturality follow from the Kan-extension adjunction.

Commute sum extension with sheafification by uniqueness of left adjoints; apply strong monoidality of sheafification, its counit isomorphisms on sheaves, and the restriction model of etale inverse image. Compose these isomorphisms. Their naturality and lanProjectionMap_naturality yield joint naturality. This is exactly the existing source proof, not a new obligation.
